rustfs.runtime_note: The preview tag is the latest release label but intentionally publishes no Docker image. The published rc.6 runtime tag resolves to the same source commit.

rustfs.rollback_policy: Version-specific rollback floors apply upstream; universal binary downgrade safety is not assumed. Recovery must follow the documented version-compatible rollback/recovery path.
